_note: GET /api/ideas?space_id=spc_default as of PR #320 (908c335), stacked on #319. Names, ids and takes are made up. peeks_today counts every take started today (scan and Look now); only scan takes count toward daily_cap, so "2 of 3 peeks left today" is daily_cap minus the scan takes, and cap_reached is the cap-reached line (true also when daily_cap is 0). While status is peeking, kwant_id is the bot peeking and peeked_at is since when; once the take is written, kwant_id is its author. failed keeps error set; Look now on it tries again. take is null until a bot has peeked; mission_id is the DRAFT mission Do it made. Live updates arrive as SSE idea_updated {id, status, space_id} (status deleted after DELETE).

take.title: Dark mode
take.why: Most sessions in the usage log start after 8 pm, and the white board is the most-mentioned complaint. The theme tokens already exist, so this is mostly wiring and a contrast pass on the charts.
risks: Chart colours may drop below 4.5:1 contrast on a dark background
Screenshots in the docs will look out of date
